source_information.dataset_title: NASA FIRMS VIIRS 375m Active Fire Satellite Observation Archive
source_information.provider: NASA Land, Atmosphere Near real-time Capability for EOS (LANCE) / FIRMS
source_information.citation: Schroeder, W., Oliva, P., Giglio, L., & Csiszar, I. (2014). The New VIIRS 375 m active fire detection data product: Algorithm description and initial assessment. Remote Sensing of Environment, 143, 85-96.

features.description: Center latitude of the active fire pixel referenced to WGS-84 ellipsoid.
Center longitude of the active fire pixel referenced to WGS-84 ellipsoid.
VIIRS Band I4 (3.55–3.93 µm) mid-wave infrared brightness temperature of the fire pixel. Saturates at ~367K.
Along-scan pixel dimension representing spatial footprint widening toward scan edges.
Along-track pixel dimension representing along-orbit satellite footprint.
Date of satellite sensor observation in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).
Time of satellite overpass observation in UTC hours and minutes.
Operational polar-orbiting satellite platform that acquired the radiance observation.
Visible Infrared Imaging Radiometer Suite sensor identifier.
Detection quality flag assigned by contextual temperature thresholding and cloud-mask checks.
NASA FIRMS Near Real-Time processing algorithm version identifier.
VIIRS Band I5 (10.5–12.4 µm) thermal infrared brightness temperature of the observation.
Fire Radiative Power quantifying the instantaneous rate of radiative heat energy release.
Solar illumination flag distinguishing daytime ascending passes from nocturnal descending passes.
